text: Lesmana Wijaya grows rich through a priestess's black magic and then lies in a coma with a mysterious illness. His estranged daughter Alfie goes back to the abandoned family villa, her childhood home, where her stepmother Laksmi is searching for valuables, and a [sealed cellar door is broken open|trigger|unsealing what was shut away]. A presence possesses the family one by one, and in the cellar waits a set of [dolls made from each family member's hair|images|dolls, masks and likenesses], the price of [a father's pact with a concubine of the devil|wrong|bargains with dark powers].
